facts.text: gazebo_gymnasium_bridge documents reinforcement-learning agents training in Gazebo through the standard Gymnasium API.
The clone targets Linux x86-64 only and its locked environment provides ROS 2 Jazzy and Gazebo Harmonic.
The Pixi environment supplies Gazebo Harmonic with its gz.sim Python bindings.
The registered env ids map GazeboCartPole-v0 to the cartpole agent spec; GazeboCartPoleContinuous-v0 is a separate registration.
register_envs registers each id with entry point gazebo_gymnasium_bridge.envs.gym_env:GazeboEnv and kwargs {'agent': agent}.
GazeboEnv.__init__ takes agent='cartpole' by default, reads its spaces from get_spec(agent), and builds InProcessHarnessVecEnv with n_agents=1 and autoreset=False.
GazeboEnv.reset calls gym.Env.reset(seed=seed), seeds the vector environment only when a seed is given, calls its reset(), and returns the first observation with an empty info dictionary.
GazeboEnv.step sends one action through step_async/step_wait, pops TimeLimit.truncated from info, reports terminated only when done and not truncated, and returns the five-value Gymnasium tuple.
_cartpole_action_to_commands rounds the action to an integer and commands a slider_to_cart force of +_CART_FORCE (10.0) for action 1 and -10.0 for any other action.
The cartpole spec declares action_space=spaces.Discrete(2).
The cartpole observation space is Box with low [-4.8, -inf, -0.41887903, -inf], high [4.8, inf, 0.41887903, inf] and shape (4,), in float32.
The observation order is cart position, cart velocity, pole angle and pole angular velocity from the slider_to_cart and cart_to_pole joints.
Cartpole reset puts the cart at zero position and velocity and draws the pole angle uniformly from -0.05 to 0.05 with zero angular velocity.
The cartpole pole-angle threshold is 0.20944 and the cart-position threshold is 2.4.
The cartpole terminated_fn returns true when the absolute pole angle or the absolute cart position exceeds its threshold.
The cartpole reward function always returns 1.0.
AgentSpec defaults frame_skip to 5 physics ticks per environment step and max_episode_steps to 500.
The in-process world sets a 0.01 s maximum physics step and real_time_factor 0.
step_wait calls _step_server(self.frame_skip) in both its image and its non-image branch.
_step_server calls self._server.run(True, ticks, False) and does not use its return value.
InProcessHarnessVecEnv truncates at max_episode_steps and sets info['TimeLimit.truncated'] only when the episode truncated without terminating.
InProcessHarnessVecEnv.seed replaces its generator with numpy.random.default_rng(seed).
The reset path passes that generator into Core.reset_agent for each reset agent.
Core.reset_agent calls reset_joint_state(rng) and applies every returned joint position and velocity.
InProcessHarnessVecEnv imports the native gz.sim8 bindings in its constructor.
The constructor writes the generated world SDF to a tempfile.mkstemp file, hosts it in gz_sim.TestFixture with pre- and post-update callbacks, and steps the server once.
The constructor prints a ready line naming the agent, n_agents and frame_skip.
close() unsubscribes the camera topics in image mode and removes the temporary world file; it calls no method of the TestFixture or its server.
The cartpole_bare model is an SDF with a prismatic slider_to_cart joint limited to -4..4, a revolute cart_to_pole joint with effort 1000 and velocity 8, and mass-1 slider, cart and pole links.

determinism.notes: one seed repeats the fake's pole-angle draw and its integration, but the fake uses Python's random.Random whereas the upstream vector environment uses numpy.random.default_rng, so the same seed does not reproduce an upstream Gazebo trajectory

fidelity.engine: analytic:package fake for gymnasium:GazeboCartPole-v0 (upstream engine is Gazebo Harmonic)
gaps: the fake is an analytic cartpole integrator with placeholder dynamics; it does not run Gazebo Harmonic or DART and models no contacts, friction, solver, joint effort/velocity limit or SDF inertia
the fake's gravity, mass and pole-length constants are test data, not calibrated model parameters; no trajectory was compared with an upstream Gazebo run
the fake draws the reset pole angle with Python's random.Random while the upstream environment uses numpy.random.default_rng, so one seed gives different angles on the two
the fake returns Python float lists; the upstream environment returns numpy float32 arrays of the same four values
no rendering is served; GazeboEnv metadata declares no render modes and the fake has no renderer
only GazeboCartPole-v0 is covered; the other seven registered ids, the vector and multi-agent environments and the camera-based line follower are outside this package
the real environment requires Linux, ROS 2 Jazzy, Gazebo Harmonic with gz.sim8, gymnasium and stable-baselines3; none is installed here and no Gazebo or ROS graph was opened
the fake does not model the world-fixed slider joint or the 0.60 m spawn height; cart position is the slider joint coordinate only
the upstream reset applies the drawn joint state in the pre-update callback and steps the server one 0.01 s tick before reading the observation; the fake returns the drawn state without that tick
the upstream step ignores the boolean return of server.run, so a server that does not run scores the transition on the previous observation; the fake cannot model that swallowed failure

fake-only contract: no sim backend is declared; live construction (never run here) would host gz-sim inside the server process through gz.sim8.TestFixture, write a temporary world SDF, print a ready line to standard output (which corrupts an MHS server that speaks over stdio), and its close() removes only that file and leaves the TestFixture server alive

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: simulation advancement stops: after an e-stop no step or reset is accepted until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, and the last observation and world state stay readable
